launch_rule: Every prelaunch acquisition requirement and historical regression needs hash-bound test/live evidence or an Astra-reviewed validity-preserving limitation. Required raw CPU/model capture, loss and overhead failures cannot be waived as limitations. D9 final accuracy and cross-hardware transfer are outcome checks, not fabricated prelaunch successes.

requirements.prelaunch_proof: Archive/hash source and comparison audit; never substitute cost or another agent score for matching E2E.

requirements.prelaunch_proof: Real pilot evaluator path plus resolved/unresolved/error ingestion and wrong-provenance negative tests.

requirements.prelaunch_proof: Pilot aggregation joins exact IDs; category membership, per-sample counts and phase definitions checked.

requirements.nonrecoverable_capture: Raw relevant filesystem/process operation records: event/action/parent identity, PID/TID/start identity, operation, start/end/duration or explicit censoring, actual return/status, observed paths/fds/work. Retain read/write/traversal and subprocess evidence, not just totals.
requirements.postrun_acceptance: Preserve raw records and derive summaries afterward; model/report individual operations with declared taxonomy. No aggregate-only fallback or sampling away required evidence.
requirements.prelaunch_proof: Full-mode real collector fixture proves individual records for read/write/traversal/find-exec/pipelines/tests/failure/timeout; independently compare expected operations and measured work; zero dropped required records/map failures.

requirements.nonrecoverable_capture: Exact intended and dispatched action before execution; executable/subcommand/module, pipeline/process structure, test runner/scope, actual container cwd, pre-action script contents/descriptors/hash/generation where known.

requirements.prelaunch_proof: Script-edit-before-execution, stale-state, persistent-cwd and compound-action negative fixtures; no host-file substitution or future-state feature.

requirements.nonrecoverable_capture: Every physical request ID, logical/client ID, retry linkage, durable pre-dispatch raw request bytes/hash, response/partial-error bytes, start/end/status, transport failure/timeout and actual usage.

requirements.nonrecoverable_capture: Input/output/context tokens with definitions and provenance; client estimate separate from native usage; serving queue/prefill/decode/cache metrics when reliable, raw snapshots and exclusive-request attribution witness.

requirements.prelaunch_proof: Long-request fixture; exact usage/raw-response match; reset/concurrent-traffic/missing-metric tests reject false per-request attribution.

requirements.nonrecoverable_capture: Actual CPU capability/clock assumptions, resource/fault/I/O counters when measured; GPU UUID/model/form factor/VRAM/clocks/driver/CUDA; model/tokenizer/config/precision/weight/KV architecture; serving/cache policy.

requirements.prelaunch_proof: Hash-bound real CPU and remote GPU profiles, sources/units/availability; model-facing parameter validation rejects fake thread scaling and unmeasured physical I/O.
